error.warming: Analytics is still warming up — no data yet
event.kind.pg.log.error_group_observed.d: A group of similar errors from the PostgreSQL log; the count is repetitions per bucket
event.kind.pg.checkpoint.started.label: checkpoint started
event.kind.pg.checkpoint.started.desc: Checkpoint started: dirty buffers are being flushed to disk
event.kind.pg.checkpoint.completed.label: checkpoint completed
event.kind.pg.checkpoint.completed.desc: Checkpoint finished; duration and buffer counts are in the message
event.kind.pg.checkpoint.too_frequent_re: Checkpoints are requested more often than checkpoint_warning — usually max_wal_size should be raised
event.kind.pg.maintenance.autoanalyze_re: Automatic ANALYZE of a table by the autovacuum daemon
event.kind.pg.maintenance.autovacuum_rep: Automatic VACUUM of a table by the autovacuum daemon
A query slower than log_min_duration_statement; duration is in the duration column
event.kind.pg.lock.acquired_after_wait_r: The process got its lock after a noticeable wait
event.kind.pg.lock.wait_reported.label: lock wait
event.kind.pg.lock.wait_reported.desc: A process has waited on a lock longer than deadlock_timeout — a sign of row/table contention
event.kind.pg.lifecycle.child_signal_ter: A PostgreSQL child process was terminated by a signal
event.kind.pg.lifecycle.child_process_cr: A PostgreSQL child process crashed; the postmaster terminates the remaining backends and enters crash recovery — seconds of downtime
event.kind.pg.lifecycle.ready_observed.d: PostgreSQL is ready to accept connections
event.kind.collector.pg_log_gap.label: log read gap
event.kind.collector.pg_log_gap.desc: The collector skipped part of the PostgreSQL log (rotation or overload)
event.kind.pg.temp_file.reported.label: temporary file
event.kind.pg.temp_file.reported.desc: A query wrote a temporary file — work_mem was too small for a sort or hash
metric.activity.wait.label: wait
metric.activity.wait.desc: Total session wait time per bucket (wait_event)
metric.activity.cpu.label: CPU
metric.activity.cpu.desc: Session processes CPU share: (utime + stime) / interval
metric.activity.io.label: I/O
metric.activity.active_fraction.label: active
metric.activity.active_fraction.desc: Share of active sessions among bucket observations
metric.statements.time.label: time
metric.statements.time.desc: Total execution time of the statement per bucket, ms
metric.statements.calls.label: calls
metric.statements.io.label: I/O, blocks
metric.statements.io.desc: Blocks read by the statement per bucket (shared + local)
metric.statements.temp.label: temp, blocks
metric.statements.temp.desc: Blocks written to temporary files per bucket (spills when work_mem is short)
metric.plans.time.label: time
metric.plans.time.desc: Total execution time of the plan per bucket, µs
metric.plans.calls.label: calls
metric.tables.io.label: I/O, blocks
metric.tables.io.desc: Blocks read for the table per bucket (heap + index + toast)
metric.tables.writes.label: writes
metric.tables.dead.label: dead
metric.tables.dead.desc: Share of dead tuples in the table
metric.indexes.io.label: I/O, blocks
metric.indexes.io.desc: Blocks read for the index per bucket
metric.indexes.scans.label: scans
metric.vacuum.progress.label: progress
metric.vacuum.progress.desc: Share of heap blocks processed (heap_blks_scanned / heap_blks_total)
metric.processes.cpu.label: CPU
metric.processes.io.label: I/O
metric.locks.wait.label: wait
metric.locks.wait.desc: Max observed lock wait/hold time per bucket
metric.events.count.label: events
metric.events.count.desc: Events of this type per bucket
metric.os.load_per_cpu.label: load/CPU
metric.os.load_per_cpu.desc: Host load average per logical CPU
metric.os.psi_io_some.label: PSI I/O
metric.os.psi_io_some.desc: Pressure Stall Information: share of time tasks stalled on I/O, %
col.pid.label: PID
col.pid.desc: OS process ID / PostgreSQL backend PID
col.user.label: user
col.user.desc: PostgreSQL role the session runs as
col.database.label: database
col.application.label: application
col.backend_type.label: backend type
col.backend_type.desc: Process type: client backend, autovacuum worker, walsender etc.
col.state.label: state
col.state.desc: Session state: active, idle, idle in transaction
col.wait_event.label: wait event
col.wait_event.desc: What the session is waiting on right now (Lock, IO, Client…)
col.query.label: query
col.statements.query.label: query
col.statements.query.desc: Normalized text: literals replaced with $1, $2… parameters
col.query_duration_us.label: query duration
col.query_duration_us.desc: Runtime of the session's current query; hours — a stuck session pins the snapshot and locks
col.transaction_duration_us.label: transaction age
col.transaction_duration_us.desc: Age of the open transaction; a long idle-in-transaction holds locks and blocks vacuum
col.cpu.label: CPU
col.cpu.desc: CPU share over the interval: (utime + stime) / time
col.replication_state.label: replication
col.sync_state.label: sync state
col.sync_state.desc: Replica sync_state: async, potential, sync, quorum
col.replay_lag_us.label: replay lag
col.replay_lag_us.desc: Replica replay lag behind the primary; minutes or more — RPO risk on failover
col.queryid.label: query ID
col.queryid.desc: queryid from pg_stat_statements — stable identifier of a normalized query (uint64)
col.calls.label: calls
col.total.label: total time
col.ms_per_row.label: ms/row
col.mean.label: mean
col.plans.mean.label: mean
col.time_pct.label: % time
col.time_pct.desc: Statement share of the instance's total execution time
col.plan_time_pct.label: % planning
col.plan_time_pct.desc: Planning time share of the statement's total time
col.rows.label: rows
col.hit_pct.label: hit %
col.hit_pct.desc: Share of reads served from the buffer cache; low values mean disk reads
col.blks_read.label: read, blocks
col.temp_written.label: temp, blocks
col.temp_written.desc: Blocks written to temporary files — sort/hash spills when work_mem is short
col.wal_bytes.label: WAL
col.wal_bytes.desc: WAL bytes generated by the statement
col.planid.label: plan ID
col.planid.desc: planid from pg_store_plans — stable plan identifier (uint64)
col.plan.label: plan
col.plan.desc: Text representation of the execution plan
col.shared_hit.label: hit, blocks
col.shared_read.label: read, blocks
col.shared_read.desc: Blocks read from disk into shared buffers
col.first_seen.label: first seen
col.first_seen.desc: When this plan was first observed
col.last_seen.label: last seen
col.last_seen.desc: When this plan was last observed
col.relation.label: relation
col.size.label: size
col.seq_scan.label: seq scan
col.seq_scan.desc: Sequential scans of the table; growth on a large table — a missing index
col.idx_scan.label: index scan
col.dead_pct.label: dead, %
col.dead_pct.desc: Share of dead tuples; high values mean the table needs vacuum
col.io_hit_pct.label: I/O hit %
col.io_hit_pct.desc: Share of reads served from cache for this relation (heap + index + toast)
col.xid_age.label: XID age
col.xid_age.desc: Age of the oldest xmin in transactions — distance to transaction wraparound
col.mxid_age.label: MXID age
col.mxid_age.desc: Age of the oldest multixact — distance to multixact wraparound
col.dead_tuples.label: dead tuples
col.seq_scan_pct.label: seq %
col.seq_scan_pct.desc: Share of sequential scans among all table scans
col.modified_since_analyze.label: modified since analyze
col.modified_since_analyze.desc: Rows modified since the last ANALYZE — planner statistics staleness
col.inserted_since_vacuum.label: inserted since vacuum
col.inserted_since_vacuum.desc: Rows inserted since the last VACUUM
col.last_autovacuum.label: last autovacuum
col.last_autovacuum.desc: Time of the table's last automatic vacuum
col.autovacuum_age_seconds.label: autovacuum age
col.autovacuum_age_seconds.desc: Time since the last autovacuum; growing together with the dead-tuple share — autovacuum can't keep up
col.autoanalyze_age_seconds.label: autoanalyze age
col.autoanalyze_age_seconds.desc: Time since the last autoanalyze; growing with the change count — planner statistics go stale
col.index.label: index
col.table.label: table
col.vacuum.table.label: table OID
col.vacuum.table.desc: relid — numeric OID of the relation being vacuumed
col.scans.label: scans
col.scans.desc: Index scans; zero on a large index makes it a drop candidate
col.rows_per_scan.label: rows/scan
col.last_idx_scan.label: last scan
col.last_idx_scan.desc: Time the index was last used; empty under live load — dead index, drop candidate
col.phase.label: phase
col.phase.desc: Vacuum phase: scanning heap, vacuuming indexes, truncating heap etc.
col.is_autovacuum.label: auto
col.is_autovacuum.desc: Started by the autovacuum daemon, not manually
col.progress.label: progress
col.elapsed.label: elapsed
col.elapsed.desc: Time the current vacuum has been running; hours without a phase change — stuck (lock wait or cost delay)
col.processes.type.label: type
col.processes.type.desc: Process type: backend, checkpointer, walwriter etc.
col.events.type.label: type (code)
col.events.type.desc: Raw numeric event category code from the log
col.rss.label: RSS
col.rss.desc: Resident Set Size — memory held by the process
col.threads.label: threads
col.pss.label: PSS
col.pss.desc: Proportional Set Size — RSS with shared memory split fairly between processes
col.read_bytes_per_second.label: read/s
col.write_bytes_per_second.label: write/s
col.block_delay.label: I/O delay
col.block_delay.desc: Share of process time spent in block I/O wait
col.command.label: command
col.cgroup.label: cgroup
col.cgroup.desc: Process cgroup — container or systemd unit
col.depth.label: depth
col.depth.desc: Process depth in the lock wait chain
col.root_pid.label: root PID
col.root_pid.desc: PID of the root blocker of the wait chain
col.blocked_by.label: blocked by
col.blocked_by.desc: PID of the process holding the needed lock
col.user_application.label: user / application
col.lock.label: lock
col.lock.desc: Lock wait event: Lock:relation, Lock:tuple etc.
col.granted.label: granted
col.granted.desc: The lock is granted (held) or only waited for
col.lock_mode.label: mode
col.lock_type.label: object type
col.lock_type.desc: Locked object type: relation, tuple, transactionid etc.
col.target.label: target
col.wait_or_hold_us.label: wait/hold
col.wait_or_hold_us.desc: How long the process waits for or holds the lock
col.time.label: time
col.severity.label: severity (code)
col.severity.desc: Raw numeric severity code from the log
col.severity_code.label: severity
col.category_code.label: type
col.category_code.desc: Event type: checkpoint, autovacuum, slow query, error etc.
col.duration.label: duration
col.duration.desc: Operation duration: checkpoint, vacuum, slow query
col.message.label: message
col.message.desc: Message text from the PostgreSQL log
col.detail.label: detail
col.statements.database.desc: Database the statement ran in (dbid from pg_stat_statements)
col.statements.user.desc: Role the statement ran as (userid from pg_stat_statements)
